basis: Alpha-expansin, AtEXPA7 ortholog per Ke Table S2 (EXPA7 root-hair specific, Lin 2011); root-hair cluster marker in Ke 2025 (cl8 pct 0.54 vs 0.02) and Zhang 2023 (cl6). Not validated in situ in wheat.

Cellulose synthase-like D1 (NCBI name; UniProt A0A3B5ZUD5 cellulose synthase domain); CSLD1 is required for root hair elongation in rice (OsCSLD1). Root-hair cluster DE in Ke 2025 (cl8 0.47 vs 0.05) and Zhang 2023 (cl6); ortholog not checked; no wheat in situ.
bHLH named RHL1-like (rice OsRHL1 is a root-hair bHLH); root-hair cluster DE and MINI-EX regulon in Ke 2025 (cl8 0.35 vs 0.07); ortholog identity not checked; no validation.

Glycine-rich cell wall protein (uncharacterized); outer-layer Stereo-seq signal (Ke 2025 Fig 2B, S3, Table S5; cl7 0.95 vs 0.25) and top-100 marker of Zhang 2023 epidermis/cortex I (cl0, epidermis and cortex merged). Pan-epidermal.
Glycine-rich cell wall protein 1 (uncharacterized); outer-layer Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl7 0.86 vs 0.17) and Zhang 2023 epidermis/cortex I marker (cl0, merged with cortex).

NCBI "chitinase CLP-like", ortholog of rice epidermis/root-hair CLP Os01g0937050 (Ke Table S2), but UniProt A0A3B6H0Q3 is a peptidase A1 domain protein; outer-layer Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl7 0.41 vs 0.04).

Class III peroxidase of a monocot-specific triad; outer-layer Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Fig S8); DE in Ke epidermis cl1 (0.56 vs 0.12), also cl13. Cl1 identity unresolved (young epidermis, hair lineage or hypodermis).
B homeolog of the monocot-specific peroxidase triad (Ke 2025 Fig S8); DE in cl1 (0.69 vs 0.18) and root-hair cl8; not epidermis-subtype specific.
Hybrid proline-rich/LTP-domain protein (UniProt W4ZQ03), conserved cortex orthogroup across 4 species (Ke Table S9); cortex Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Fig S7, Table S5; cl2 0.61 vs 0.17).
HyPRP, ortholog of rice cortex HyPRP12/OsHyPRP06 LOC_Os04g46810 (Ke Table S2; that rice gene is high in rice_root.tsv); cortex Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Table S5); weakly specific (cl2 0.75 vs 0.30).
Hydrophobic seed/LTP-domain protein (UniProt A0A3B5ZYG6); cortex Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl2 0.69 vs 0.18).
Tandem paralog of TraesCS1D03G0787300; cortex Stereo-seq gene used for plotting (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl2 0.71 vs 0.18).
Monocot-specific lipid transfer protein; cortex Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Fig 4M, Table S5; cl2 0.59 vs 0.12). Ke cortex may include hypodermis.

Casparian strip membrane protein 1 (UniProt E6Y2A0, named TaCASP1/TaSTG; CASP family function per Roppolo 2014 Plant Physiol); endodermis DE in Ke 2025 (cl9 0.26 vs 0.04) and Zhang 2023 endodermis II marker (cl17). No wheat in situ.
D homeolog of TaCASP1 (UniProt CASP-like A0A1D5ULL7); endodermis DE in Ke 2025 (cl9 0.21 vs 0.03) and Zhang 2023 endodermis II marker (cl17). Low detection; no wheat in situ.
MYB36 ortholog (Casparian strip master regulator in Arabidopsis); top endodermis regulon and DE in Ke 2025 (cl9 0.36 vs 0.02). Not validated in wheat.
A homeolog of MYB36-like; endodermis regulon and DE in Ke 2025 (cl9 0.33 vs 0.02). Not validated in wheat.
Vacuolar iron transporter (UniProt A0A3B6MRV7); endodermis Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Fig S4C, Table S5; cl9 0.41 vs 0.04) and Zhang 2023 endodermis I marker (cl10).
Class III peroxidase (lignification); endodermis Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl9 0.92 vs 0.23) and Zhang 2023 endodermis I and II marker (cl10, cl17).

R2R3-MYB annotated MYB36 (Casparian-strip regulator in Arabidopsis and rice); cl10 endodermis I-only in top-100 and on the endodermis pseudotime branch (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2, Fig 3d); ortholog not checked; no localization. Also endodermis-specific in Ke 2025 (cl9 0.36 vs 0.03). Not raised: no validation in either study (same rule as TaCASP1). A second MYB36-like pair (6A/6D rows) is also endodermal; which pair is the MYB36 ortholog is unresolved.
Homeolog of the 5A MYB36-like gene; cl10-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2). Also endodermis-specific in Ke 2025 (cl9 0.31 vs 0.02). Not raised: no validation.

WALLS ARE THIN1 homolog; RNA in situ in provascular cells at the elongation-zone start (Zhang 2023 Fig 2g, cl5) and DE in Ke 2025 provascular cl4 (0.71 vs 0.22). Raise withheld: also endodermis-enriched in both studies (Ke cl9; Zhang cl10) and Zhang protoxylem.
A-genome WAT1-like; DE in Ke 2025 provascular cl4 (0.80 vs 0.27; also cl9, cl14) and Zhang 2023 provascular marker (cl5). Not the in situ probe gene.
Uncharacterized; Ke 2025 provascular cl4 (0.59 vs 0.24) with central Stereo-seq signal the authors attribute partly to diffusion (Fig S4A); Zhang 2023 provascular marker (cl5).

Argonaute (UniProt: PNH1; Arabidopsis AGO10/ZLL is provascular/stem-cell expressed); cl5 provascular-only in top-100 (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2, Supplementary Note); no localization in wheat; WAT1 in situ for cl5 is already in markers_draft. Not DE in Ke 2025.
Homeolog of the 7B AGO10-like gene; cl5-only top-100 (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2). Not DE in Ke 2025.

Xylem cysteine peptidase (tracheary-element autolysis, Avci 2008); RNA in situ in protoxylem (Zhang 2023 Fig 2f, cl13) and xylem Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Fig 4F; cl10 0.98 vs 0.13). Conflict: also DE in Ke root cap cl14 (0.89).

A homeolog of XCP1-like (joint homeolog probe, Zhang 2023 Fig 2f, protoxylem cl13); xylem Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl10 0.96 vs 0.13). Also DE in Ke root cap cl14. Kept high after the full Zhang review (which rates the homeologs medium because the joint probe cannot resolve them): Ke Table S5 lists this homeolog among the Stereo-seq-patterned xylem genes, so the validation does not rest on the Zhang probe alone.

B homeolog of XCP1-like (joint homeolog probe, Zhang 2023 Fig 2f, protoxylem cl13); Ke 2025 xylem DE (cl10 0.97 vs 0.12) among Stereo-seq-patterned top DEGs. Also DE in Ke root cap cl14. Kept high after the full Zhang review (which rates the homeologs medium because the joint probe cannot resolve them): Ke Table S5 lists this homeolog among the Stereo-seq-patterned xylem genes, so the validation does not rest on the Zhang probe alone.
NAC "37-like" (VND1 homolog per Zhang Table S14); VND NACs drive vessel differentiation. Xylem DE in Ke 2025 (cl10 0.26 vs 0.008) and Zhang 2023 protoxylem marker (cl13); no wheat in situ.
D homeolog of VND1-like; xylem DE in Ke 2025 (cl10 0.23 vs 0.01) and Zhang 2023 protoxylem marker (cl13); no wheat in situ.
NAC ortholog of AtVND4 (Ke MINI-EX regulon, Fig 5B); xylem DE in Ke 2025 only (cl10 0.31 vs 0.01). Not validated in wheat.

LRR receptor kinase, VRLK1-like; conserved xylem orthogroup across 4 species (Ke Table S9); Ke cl10 0.57 vs 0.04; no validation. A second VRLK1-like gene (TraesCS4B03G0486500) is a Zhang 2023 metaxylem (cl11) marker and Ke xylem DE; see the Metaxylem rows.

bHLH annotated TMO5 (AT3G25710, protoxylem-precursor bHLH in Arabidopsis); top cl13 (protoxylem) marker only there; no wheat localization; ortholog not checked (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2). Protoxylem-side marker (Zhang cl13). Ke 2025 xylem cl10 DE (0.43 vs 0.05) but also root cap cl14 (0.37), like XCP1. Two atlases, no validation, so not raised.
TMO5-like bHLH paralog, cl13-only in top-100 (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2); no localization; ortholog not checked. Not DE in Ke 2025.

GT43 xylan synthase annotated IRX9 (secondary-wall xylan); top-100 marker of cl11 'metaxylem' only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2 and Supplementary Note); no validation; label inferred from lignin/xylan genes, so check against protoxylem markers. Ke 2025: DE in xylem cl10 (0.57 vs 0.26) and cl11 (0.61 vs 0.26), not specific. Use only within Xylem-marked cells (requires is for trait tags, so this is not encoded).

Laccase annotated LAC5 (lignin polymerisation); cl11-only in top-100 (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2); no validation. Conflict: in Ke 2025 it is DE only in cl11 "Endodermis/Phloem" (0.36 vs 0.08), which the draft reads as immature SE; Ke cl11 also shares 7 genes with Zhang metaxylem, so it may hold early metaxylem. Use within Xylem-marked cells.

LRR-RLK annotated VRLK1 (vascular secondary-wall timing in Arabidopsis); cl11-only in top-100 (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2); no validation. Ke 2025 xylem cl10 DE (0.49 vs 0.02; also root cap 0.35). Paralog/homeolog of the VRLK1-like Xylem row (TraesCS4D03G0434100). Proto- vs metaxylem rests on the unvalidated Zhang cl11 label.
Uncharacterized (LOC119361884 triad); discrete phloem-pole Stereo-seq spots (Ke 2025 Fig 2D, Table S5; cl13 0.95 vs 0.03). SE vs CC unresolved.
B homeolog of the phloem triad; Stereo-seq phloem pattern (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl13 0.95 vs 0.06).
Early nodulin-like phytocyanin, ortholog of AtENODL15 (sieve element, Khan 2007); phloem Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl13 0.72 vs 0.03).
AWPM-19-like membrane protein (At phloem ortholog, Ke Table S2); very specific in Ke 2025 (cl13 0.88 vs 0.007) but not spatially validated.

MYB annotated APL homolog by Zhang Table S14 (APL specifies phloem SE and CC); Zhang 2023 protophloem marker (cl16); in Ke 2025 DE in "Pericycle*" cl6 (0.34 vs 0.016), which matches companion cells (see README). No wheat in situ.

Defensin; Ke 2025 used it for "Pericycle*" (cl6 0.85 vs 0.25) but it is equally DE in phloem cl13 and cl11, and Zhang 2023 lists it for protophloem (cl16). Conflict: pericycle (Ke manual call) vs phloem.
Uncharacterized kinase; Ke 2025 "Pericycle*" marker with partial pericycle-ring Stereo-seq signal (Fig S4E), but DE higher in phloem cl13 (0.84) than in cl6 (0.73). Conflict: pericycle vs phloem.

MYB annotated APL (phloem identity TF); cl16 protophloem-only in top-100 (two other APL homologs also in cl21) (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2); APL expression drops in taspl14 knockout roots (Fig S13), not a localization. B-genome APL-like gene, distinct from the APL-like 7A row. Not DE in Ke 2025.
Dof TF annotated PEAR2 (protophloem-sieve-element early Dof); cl16-only in top-100 (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2); no localization. Not DE in Ke 2025. Protophloem (SE-side) by function.

CLV1-related RLK annotated BAM1 (represses protophloem differentiation); cl16-only in top-100; predicted TaSPL14 target, down in taspl14 knockout (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 5g, Table S2). The 4D homolog used in Fig 5h is not in the top-100. Not DE in Ke 2025.

Sucrose transporter of the SE-CC complex; TaSUT1 mRNA localized to companion cells by in situ (protein in the SE plasma membrane) in leaf, sheath and internode (Aoki et al. 2004 Planta; IWGSC ID TraesCS4A02G016400 per the characterized-markers survey, which confirms the TaSUT1-4A identity; UniProt Q8S4W1). In root: Zhang 2023 companion-cell marker (cl21; also a top marker of the rejected "XPP" cl4) and Ke 2025 cl6 DE (0.20 vs 0.03), which matches companion cells. Raised medium->high (2026-10-20): characterized in situ in an independent study plus cluster-specific in two atlases; caveat: the in situ was not done in root. Low detection (about 20% of cells).
Annexin D5-like; ANN5 homolog used as a companion-cell marker in Zhang 2023 (cl21; qPCR in taspl14) and specific in Ke 2025 cl6 (0.50 vs 0.018). Two independent atlases, no in situ.
A homeolog of annexin D5-like; Zhang 2023 companion-cell marker (cl21) and Ke 2025 cl6 (0.42 vs 0.014).

B homeolog of TaSUT1 (listed with 4A/4D in the characterized-markers survey; Aoki et al. 2004 Planta in situ in leaf/stem companion cells, homeolog resolution of the probe not stated). Zhang 2023 companion-cell marker (cl21 top-100); not DE in Ke 2025 Table S4.

D homeolog of TaSUT1 (Aoki et al. 2004 Planta, leaf/stem companion-cell in situ; homeolog resolution not stated). Ke 2025 cl6 DE (0.21 vs 0.014; cl6 matches companion cells, see README); not in the Zhang top-100.

LIM-domain DA1/DAR family; joint 4A/4B/4D probe gives a radially oriented dotted vascular signal assigned to companion cells by RNA in situ (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2e, Table S14); cl21-only in top-100. Table S2 lists the Arabidopsis homolog as DA1 (AT1G19270), not DAR2 (AT2G39830), so the DAR2 name is not supported by the paper's own table. Not DE in Ke 2025.
Homeolog in the same joint in situ probe (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2e, Table S14); cl21-only; UniProt A0A1L6K401 is named DA2; homolog naming unresolved. Not DE in Ke 2025.

Homeolog in the same joint in situ probe (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2e, Table S14); cl21-only. Ke 2025: DE in merged phloem cl13 (0.25 vs 0.02), not in cl6. Raise withheld: Ke cl13 is merged SE/CC phloem, not a companion-cell call.
Metacaspase annotated LOL3/MC1; cl21-only top-100 marker; down in taspl14 knockout (Fig S13) (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol); no localization. Not DE in Ke 2025.

Phloem-protein-2 F-box; Zhang 2023 immature sieve element marker (cl14) and Ke 2025 Table S2 marker of the mixed "Endodermis/Phloem" cl11 (0.53 vs 0.03), which matches Zhang immature SE. No validation in either. Same symbol as in NCBI (all three PP2-B F-box homeologs are "putative F-box protein PP2-B12" in Ke Table S4); Zhang Table S2 gives the Arabidopsis homolog as PP2-B11 (AT1G80110). Not raised after the full Zhang review (cl14 Adopt, no in situ).
D homeolog; Zhang 2023 immature SE marker (cl14) and Ke 2025 cl11 (0.54 vs 0.04). No validation. Zhang Table S2 gives the Arabidopsis homolog as PP2-B10 (AT2G02360); NCBI name PP2-B12.
1,3-beta-glucan synthase (UniProt A0A3B6NY90; sieve-plate callose is made by CalS7 in Arabidopsis, ortholog not checked); Zhang 2023 immature SE marker (cl14) and Ke 2025 cl11 (0.29 vs 0.012).

F-box/PP2-B family; cl14-only top-100 marker (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2); no localization. NCBI name PP2-B12 (Ke Table S4). Ke 2025 cl11 DE (0.44 vs 0.05), like the 6A/6D rows. Graded like its homeologs (the Zhang review had expression medium); no validation in either study.

AP2/ERF annotated PLT1 (stem-cell niche/distal meristem TF); cl18 'SCN'-only in top-100 (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2, Supplementary Note); PLT genes form a meristem-wide gradient, so not QC-specific; no localization. Cluster of about 20 nuclei, one library. Not DE in Ke 2025 (no SCN cluster there).
PLT1-like paralog, cl18-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2). Hypothesis only (cl18, about 20 nuclei).
PLT1-like paralog, cl18-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2). Hypothesis only (cl18, about 20 nuclei).
PLT1-like paralog, cl18-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2). Hypothesis only (cl18, about 20 nuclei).
Peptide annotated RGF1 (root meristem growth factor, acts on PLT); cl18-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2); uncharacterized in UniProt. Hypothesis only (cl18, about 20 nuclei).
RGF1-like homeolog, cl18-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2). Hypothesis only (cl18, about 20 nuclei).
Peptide annotated RGF3; cl18-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2). Hypothesis only (cl18, about 20 nuclei).

LEA-like protein, ortholog of Arabidopsis LRC gene At5g60530 (Ke Table S2); root-cap Stereo-seq ring (Ke 2025 Fig 2F, Table S5; cl14 0.84 vs 0.01) and Zhang 2023 root-cap marker (cl15). Columella vs LRC unresolved.
Pathogenesis-related protein 1 (UniProt A0A9R1MFX3); root-cap Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl14 0.84 vs 0.003).
Stigma-specific STIG1-like protein (UniProt A0A3B6GR08); root-cap Stereo-seq (Ke 2025 Table S5; cl14 0.86 vs 0.015).

NAC (UniProt W5B7L7) named BRN2 by the authors (Arabidopsis BRN1/BRN2 drive outer root-cap maturation); feature plot shows cl15 specificity (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Supplementary Note Fig 6); not in the top-100 table; ortholog not checked. Not in Ke 2025 Table S4.

LEA-like (At3g19430 family; many paralogs among the cl15 top-100); cl15 root cap (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Table S2); cl15 matches Ke root cap cl14 (31 shared genes). Ke 2025 plots this gene in root-cap Stereo-seq and lists it among the top-20 DEGs with the expected pattern (Table S5); cl14 0.71 vs 0.00 (Table S4). Regraded from the Zhang review (expression medium): spatially supported in Ke (characterized_enriched medium, same convention as the LEA At5g60530-like row) and raised one level for Zhang cl15 specificity. Columella vs LRC unresolved.

[Zhang label: root border cell, cl19; review name Root_Border_Cell] JAZ (JA-signalling repressor); cl19 'root border cell' top marker; qPCR in physically collected border cells 2-18x over whole tips (joint 2A/2B/2D primers) (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2a-d, Table S14). JA/defence genes may also mark a wound state. Ke 2025: DE in heat-shock/stress cl5 (0.68 vs 0.35), not root cap, which supports a stress/wound reading. Use only inside Root_Cap-marked cells.

[Zhang label: root border cell, cl19; review name Root_Border_Cell] Homeolog in the same qPCR assay; cl19-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2, Table S14). Ke 2025: DE in root cap cl14 (0.71 vs 0.21) and stress cl5 (0.52). Use only inside Root_Cap-marked cells.

[Zhang label: root border cell, cl19; review name Root_Border_Cell] Homeolog in the same qPCR assay; cl19-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2, Table S14). Ke 2025: DE in stress cl5 only (0.38 vs 0.14).

[Zhang label: root border cell, cl19; review name Root_Border_Cell] ABCG transporter annotated PDR8/PEN3 (defence exporter); cl19-only; enriched by qPCR in collected border cells (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2, Table S14). Not DE in Ke 2025.

[Zhang label: root border cell, cl19; review name Root_Border_Cell] Pirin annotated PRN2; cl19-only (the 1A homeolog is also a cl4 marker); enriched by qPCR in collected border cells (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2, Table S14). Ke 2025: DE in root cap cl14 (0.75 vs 0.23) and cortex cl2 (0.46).

[Zhang label: root border cell, cl19; review name Root_Border_Cell] Homeolog in the same PRN2 qPCR assay; cl19-only (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2, Table S14). Ke 2025: DE in root cap cl14 (0.75 vs 0.31), cortex and stress cl5; not specific.
[Zhang label: root border cell, cl19; review name Root_Border_Cell] DUF1640 protein; cl19 marker; qPCR primer set in Table S14 (result in Fig 2a-d) (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol). Not DE in Ke 2025.
G2/M cyclin B1; Ke 2025 G2/M cl12 (0.70 vs 0.05; patchy Stereo-seq) and Zhang 2023 "meristem II" marker (cl7, a G2/M state by marker overlap).
Replication-dependent histone H4 (UniProt P62785); Ke 2025 G1/S cl3 (0.92 vs 0.24; patchy Stereo-seq). Zhang 2023 "proximal meristem" (cl3) is the same S-phase state (G-H2AX in situ).

Histone H2A.X; cl3 'proximal meristem' marker, RNA in situ in the proximal meristem above the QC (joint 5D/2B/2D probe) (Zhang et al. 2023 Genome Biol Fig 2h, Table S14). A replication-coupled histone; marks cycling cells, not a cell type. The 5D homeolog is also a cl2 and cl16 marker. Ke 2025 G1/S cl3 0.91 vs 0.57 (not specific), so not raised.
